about: Verses for the daily 'Verse of the Day'. Text is the KJV and the WEB (both public domain), copied from the app's own Bible data.

verses.kjv: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.web: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

verses.kjv: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verses.web: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

verses.kjv: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
verses.web: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
verses.web: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you, until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

verses.kjv: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
verses.web: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
verses.web: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”

verses.kjv: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
verses.web: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

verses.kjv: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
verses.web: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

verses.kjv: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
verses.web: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you. Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you. Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

verses.kjv: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.web: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

verses.kjv: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.web: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them who love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,

verses.kjv: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.web: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

verses.kjv: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.web: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

verses.kjv: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
verses.web: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

verses.kjv: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.web: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”

verses.kjv: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
verses.web: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”

verses.kjv: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
verses.web: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.

verses.kjv: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
verses.web: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”

verses.kjv: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hands.
verses.web: and that all this assembly may know that Yahweh doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is Yahweh’s, and he will give you into our hand.”

verses.kjv: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
verses.web: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

verses.kjv: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.web: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.kjv: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
verses.web: Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all.

verses.kjv: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
verses.web: if my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

verses.kjv: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
verses.web: But you be strong, and don’t let your hands be slack; for your work will be rewarded.”

verses.kjv: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
verses.web: For Yahweh’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”

verses.kjv: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
verses.web: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”

verses.kjv: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
verses.web: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”

verses.kjv: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
verses.web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

verses.kjv: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.web: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

verses.kjv: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
verses.web: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.web: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers; but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

verses.kjv: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
verses.web: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.

verses.kjv: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.web: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
verses.web: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verses.web: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

verses.kjv: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.web: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.web: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

verses.kjv: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.web: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

verses.kjv: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verses.web: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.

verses.kjv: The earth is the LORD’s, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.web: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.web: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.kjv: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
verses.web: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
verses.web: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

verses.kjv: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.web: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

verses.kjv: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
verses.web: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.

verses.kjv: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.web: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

verses.kjv: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.web: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

verses.kjv: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.web: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

verses.kjv: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.web: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

verses.kjv: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.web: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

verses.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.web: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

verses.kjv: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.web: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.kjv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.web: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”

verses.kjv: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.web: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

verses.kjv: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.web: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

verses.kjv: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
verses.web: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

verses.kjv: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.web: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

verses.kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
verses.web: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

verses.kjv: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.web: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

verses.kjv: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.web: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

verses.kjv: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
verses.web: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

verses.kjv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verses.web: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

verses.kjv: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.web: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

verses.kjv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.web: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

verses.kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name. For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
verses.web: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name. For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.web: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name! Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

verses.kjv: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.web: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

verses.kjv: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verses.web: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

verses.kjv: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.web: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

verses.kjv: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.web: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

verses.kjv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

verses.kjv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
verses.web: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.web: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul. Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

verses.kjv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.web: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

verses.kjv: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.web: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

verses.kjv: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.web: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

verses.kjv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.web: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.web: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

verses.kjv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.web: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

verses.kjv: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.web: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

verses.kjv: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.web: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

verses.kjv: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.web: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

verses.kjv: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.web: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.kjv: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.web: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

verses.kjv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
verses.web: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

verses.kjv: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.web: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

verses.kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.web: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

verses.kjv: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.web: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

verses.kjv: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.web: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

verses.kjv: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.web: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

verses.kjv: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.web: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

verses.kjv: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
verses.web: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

verses.kjv: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.web: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

verses.kjv: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
verses.web: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

verses.kjv: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.web: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

verses.kjv: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
verses.web: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

verses.kjv: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.web: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

verses.kjv: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
verses.web: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

verses.kjv: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
verses.web: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

verses.kjv: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.web: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

verses.kjv: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
verses.web: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

verses.kjv: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
verses.web: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verses.web: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
verses.web: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

verses.kjv: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
verses.web: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

verses.kjv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
verses.web: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

verses.kjv: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
verses.web: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

verses.kjv: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.web: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

verses.kjv: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.web: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

verses.kjv: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
verses.web: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’

verses.kjv: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verses.web: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.web: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

verses.kjv: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verses.web: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

verses.kjv: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verses.web: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
verses.web: and Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

verses.kjv: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
verses.web: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you.

verses.kjv: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.web: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is. For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verses.web: “Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh. For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green, and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.

verses.kjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.web: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

verses.kjv: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.web: You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verses.web: Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.

verses.kjv: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
verses.web: “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you.

verses.kjv: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
verses.web: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

verses.kjv: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.web: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

verses.kjv: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
verses.web: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

verses.kjv: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
verses.web: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

verses.kjv: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
verses.web: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

verses.kjv: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
verses.web: Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.

verses.kjv: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
verses.web: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

verses.kjv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verses.web: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’ ”

verses.kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.web: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

verses.kjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.web: Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

verses.kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.web: But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

verses.kjv: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
verses.web: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

verses.kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.web: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

verses.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.web: Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

verses.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.web: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

verses.kjv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
verses.web: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

verses.kjv: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
verses.web: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment. And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.web: Jesus said to him, “ ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’ This is the first and great commandment. A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

verses.kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
verses.web: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
verses.web: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

verses.kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
verses.web: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

verses.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
verses.web: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
verses.web: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
verses.web: He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

verses.kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
verses.web: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

verses.kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.web: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

verses.kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.web: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

verses.kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verses.web: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

verses.kjv: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verses.web: Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

verses.kjv: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
verses.web: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

verses.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.web: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

verses.kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
verses.web: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

verses.kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.web: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

verses.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.web: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

verses.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.web: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

verses.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.web: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

verses.kjv: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.web: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

verses.kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
verses.web: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

verses.kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
verses.web: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.web: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

verses.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verses.web: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

verses.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.web: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

verses.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
verses.web: If you love me, keep my commandments.

verses.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

verses.kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.web: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

verses.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.web: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

verses.kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.web: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

verses.kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
verses.web: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

verses.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
verses.web: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.web: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

verses.kjv: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.web: Peter said to them, “Repent, and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
verses.web: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

verses.kjv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
verses.web: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

verses.kjv: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
verses.web: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”

verses.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.web: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

verses.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God; Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.web: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God; being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;

verses.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.web: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

verses.kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience; And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
verses.web: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:

verses.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.web: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

verses.kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.web: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.web: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

verses.kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.web: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

verses.kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.web: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

verses.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.web: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

verses.kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
verses.web: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

verses.kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.web: No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

verses.kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.web: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verses.web: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.web: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

verses.kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.web: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

verses.kjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
verses.web: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

verses.kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.web: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

verses.kjv: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verses.web: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;

verses.kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.web: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

verses.kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verses.web: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
verses.web: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

verses.kjv: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
verses.web: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

verses.kjv: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.web: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

verses.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.web: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.web: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

verses.kjv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong. Let all your things be done with charity.
verses.web: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong! Let all that you do be done in love.

verses.kjv: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verses.web: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

verses.kjv: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
verses.web: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

verses.kjv: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
verses.web: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

verses.kjv: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
verses.web: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.web: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

verses.kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
verses.web: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.

verses.kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
verses.web: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

verses.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.web: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

verses.kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.web: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.

verses.kjv: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
verses.web: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, that no one would boast.

verses.kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
verses.web: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

verses.kjv: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
verses.web: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

verses.kjv: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
verses.web: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

verses.kjv: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verses.web: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.

verses.kjv: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
verses.web: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.web: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before, I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
verses.web: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

verses.kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
verses.web: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
verses.web: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is any praise, think about these things.

verses.kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.web: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.

verses.kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verses.web: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
verses.web: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

verses.kjv: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
verses.web: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men; Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
verses.web: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men, knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

verses.kjv: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
verses.web: Always rejoice. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

verses.kjv: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
verses.web: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

verses.kjv: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.web: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

verses.kjv: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verses.web: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

verses.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.web: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

verses.kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.web: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

verses.kjv: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.web: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

verses.kjv: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.web: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

verses.kjv: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.web: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

verses.kjv: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
verses.web: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

verses.kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.web: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

verses.kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.web: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

verses.kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us, Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.web: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

verses.kjv: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.web: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

verses.kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.web: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

verses.kjv: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
verses.web: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

verses.kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.web: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

verses.kjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verses.web: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.

verses.kjv: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.web: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

verses.kjv: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you. Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
verses.web: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you. Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

verses.kjv: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.web: Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

verses.kjv: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
verses.web: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

verses.kjv: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
verses.web: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

verses.kjv: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
verses.web: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

verses.kjv: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
verses.web: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

verses.kjv: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.web: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

verses.kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.web: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

verses.kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verses.web: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

verses.kjv: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
verses.web: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

verses.kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God. He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
verses.web: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God. He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

verses.kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verses.web: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

verses.kjv: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.web: We love him, because he first loved us.

verses.kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
verses.web: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

verses.kjv: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
verses.web: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

verses.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
verses.web: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

verses.kjv: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
verses.web: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.

verses.kjv: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
verses.web: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.”

verses.kjv: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
verses.web: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
